name: Montana Offroad Designs
about:
Montana Offroad Designs operates from Bozeman, Montana, where a team of grassroots designers founded the company to put their mark on the off-road industry. The business began with a focus on creating design-built, American-made products that help off-road enthusiasts succeed on the trail.

The company manufactures a range of off-road accessories including ARB brushless compressor mounts, rock sliders, light bar mounts, spare tire relocation kits, traction board mounts, and rear cage MOLLE panels. All products are made in the USA and are developed around a "form follows function" philosophy. The product line covers specific applications for the Ineos Grenadier, Ford Bronco, Ford F‑Series Super Duty, Ram 2500/3500, and Chevrolet/GMC 2500/3500 trucks.

Customers include individual off-road enthusiasts and commercial fleets outfitting vehicles for rugged use. Concrete examples from the catalog include the Ineos Grenadier Rock Sliders, the Ford Bronco ARB Twin Pump Compressor Mount, and the 2017‑current F‑250/F‑350 Air Compressor Mount. The company also provides installation instructions and warranty support for each product.

Montana Offroad Designs differentiates itself by emphasizing design-built, American manufacturing and a grassroots design approach. The founders set out to make off‑road journeys more successful through products engineered for specific vehicle platforms rather than universal fitments.
